textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Madhu's Wish · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Madhu loved food and wanted to eat different foods and snacks all the time. Every noon he sat under a banyan tree and ate his lunch. One day an old man came by.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Madhu loved food and wanted to eat different foods and snacks all the time. Every noon he sat under a banyan tree and ate his lunch. One day an old man came by. Madhu felt sorry for him and shared his food.
beats.speakEn: Madhu loved food and wanted to eat different foods and snacks all the time. Every noon he sat under a banyan tree and ate his lunch. One day an old man came by. Madhu felt sorry for him and shared his food.

beats.en: Madhu closed his eyes and asked for different types of food, and nothing else. A voice from the tree asked him to think it over, but Madhu said Nothing else without thinking.
beats.speakEn: Madhu closed his eyes and asked for different types of food, and nothing else. A voice from the tree asked him to think it over, but Madhu said Nothing else without thinking.

type: Key Concept: Madhu loved food and wanted to eat different foods and snacks all the time.
Rule: Madhu closed his eyes and asked for different types of food, and nothing else.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Madhu's Wish · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Madhu tried sharbat, kheer and badam milk, but his hiccups only got louder. He prayed that all the food disappear and that he get water instead. The tree asked if he was sure.

beats.en: Madhu tried sharbat, kheer and badam milk, but his hiccups only got louder. He prayed that all the food disappear and that he get water instead. The tree asked if he was sure.
beats.speakEn: Madhu tried sharbat, kheer and badam milk, but his hiccups only got louder. He prayed that all the food disappear and that he get water instead. The tree asked if he was sure.

beats.en: Forever means for all time. Immediately means at once, without waiting. Appeared means came into sight. Disappear means go out of sight. Savouries are salty snacks like samosas, kachoris and vadas.
beats.speakEn: Forever means for all time. Immediately means at once, without waiting. Appeared means came into sight. Disappear means go out of sight. Savouries are salty snacks like samosas, kachoris and vadas.
